prompt.body: Heavy metal with late-80s hard rock edge. Two electric guitars playing tight harmony lines, one with thick midrange crunch and the other with searing high-gain lead. Dual guitar harmonies in the verses, harmonized leads in the chorus. Marshall-stack tone, big bottom-end, midrange bite. NOT sludge, NOT palm-muted, NOT drop-tuned — E standard tuning. Think 1987 Sunset Strip but heavier. The vocalist is a metal screamer — high-register harsh guttural scream, aggressive, throat-tearing, alternating with guttural growl on the verses. No clean singing, no melodic voice — only screaming and growling. Drums are intense and complex: double-kick blast beats, off-time snare hits, irregular polyrhythms, complex tom fills, syncopated kick patterns. The drums are twice as busy as typical metal — every beat has a fill, every measure has a polyrhythm. No four-on-the-floor, no simple beats. The song is 3:00 of relentless forward motion. Verse: dual guitar harmonies with screaming vocals. Chorus: harmonized high-gain leads with full screaming. Bridge: blast-beat breakdown with dissonant double lead. The whole thing is dense, intricate, and brutally aggressive.
